question: Which customer region generated the most revenue? Revenue is product price times quantity, summed over order items.

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'returned' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC

answer: The South region generated the most revenue, at 1,201,250 (sum of product price × quantity over all order items, across all order statuses). West was second at 1,173,750, then North at 1,162,500 and East at 1,160,000. South is also the top region if returned orders are excluded (South 1,201,250; West 1,173,750; East 1,160,000; North has no non-returned revenue in that case).

question: Across all orders, which region brought in the highest sales (unit price x quantity)?

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY sales DESC

answer: The South region had the highest sales across all orders, at 1,201,250 (sum of product price × quantity, all statuses included). West was next at 1,173,750, followed by North at 1,162,500 and East at 1,160,000.

question: Find the top region by total revenue, where revenue = sum of price * quantity over order items.

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC

answer: The top region by total revenue is **south**, with revenue of 1,201,250.00. Revenue is the sum of price × quantity over all order items, joined to orders and customers to get the region. No order status filter was applied. Runner-up: west (1,173,750.00).

question: Rank the customer regions by revenue (price times quantity) and tell me which one is first.

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status;

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'returned' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT c.region, o.status, COUNT(*) AS items, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.region, o.status ORDER BY c.region, o.status;

answer:
South is first in revenue (price × quantity): south 1,201,250; west 1,173,750; north 1,162,500; east 1,160,000.

Excluding returned orders, south is still first (south 1,201,250; west 1,173,750; east 1,160,000), but north drops out entirely. That's because north's only orders are status 'returned'. The data also shows each region has a single order status (south=placed, west=delivered, east=shipped, north=returned), so status and region can't be separated here.
